research.question: Is first-minute movement sufficient to justify a directional trading investigation after costs?
research.target_claim: Exploratory feasibility of a perfect-direction one-minute open-to-close benchmark
research.hypothesis: The perfect-direction benchmark may retain positive net return after assumed costs.

project_choices.decision: The preregistered PROTOCOL.md at commit d4085e6 specifies the numerical gate, costs, sampling, eligibility, inference, limitations and prior exposure.

inputs: 21 previously acquired Binance Vision monthly archives
method.population: BTCUSDT spot one-minute candles January 2025 through September 2026 UTC
method.eligibility: Complete hour and immediately preceding candle; no bridging gaps; duplicate timestamps fail
method.transformations: Absolute close-to-close and open-to-close log returns in basis points; oracle abs(open-to-close); fixed costs and signed baselines.
method.acceptance_rule: Primary 24 bps round-trip: two-sided 95% confidence interval wholly above zero WORTH_FOLLOWUP; wholly below zero NOT_ECONOMICALLY_PROMISING; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE.
method.inference_criterion: 10000 deterministic UTC-week cluster bootstrap resamples, fixed seed 20261105, equally weighted hours; two-sided percentile 95% interval.

non_goals: Strategy development, parameter optimization and fresh holdout claims

study_owned.description: Decode sources and calculate exploratory economic feasibility statistics and semantic verification.
